summary: Knock Off pressures the active Ghost-type Dragapult. Rapid Spin cannot remove hazards while a Ghost immunity blocks it.

rankedActions.label: Knock Off
rankedActions.rationale: Dark damage threatens Dragapult and can remove a removable held item.
assumptions: Dragapult retains its current Ghost typing.
risks: A switch to a bulky Dark resist can reduce immediate damage.

rankedActions.label: Ice Spinner
rankedActions.rationale: Ice damage pressures Dragapult without requiring a predicted switch.
assumptions: Dragapult retains its current Dragon typing.
These illustrative scores are heuristic preferences, not calibrated win probabilities.
dangerFlags: Rapid Spin fails against an opposing Ghost immunity and does not remove hazards in that case.
Ground attacks fail against Flying types or an applicable Levitate ability; Ghost typing alone does not block them.
